top_findings: Active CSP header blocks Google Fonts and Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon, causing browser console errors on every page load.
Missing trailing-slash tool paths return HTTP 307 Temporary Redirect instead of HTTP 301 Permanent Redirect, diluting link equity consolidation.
Google-deprecated HowTo schema and retired FAQPage SERP markup present across all 38 tool routes.
CSS @import for Google Fonts creates a render-blocking waterfall that delays First Contentful Paint.
Missing /llms.txt discovery file and structured entity graph linking tools to a verified Organization publisher.
quick_wins: Self-host Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono locally in WOFF2 format to resolve CSP errors and eliminate render-blocking @import.
Populate public/_redirects with all 38 tool paths mapping non-slash URLs to trailing-slash URLs with 301 status.
Deploy public/llms.txt to provide AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude) with structured tool definitions.
Add <script type="speculationrules"> for instant hover prerendering of high-traffic tools.
Connect disconnected schema objects into a unified @graph with Organization publisher node.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 100% pre-rendered semantic HTML with zero client-side rendering blank shell risks
Valid sitemap.xml with 40 URLs declared in robots.txt
Self-referencing canonical tags on all published routes
Cloudflare HTTP/3 and edge compression (zstd/gzip) enabled
Strict HTTP 404 response on unknown probe URLs

findings.title: CSP Header Blocks Fonts and Analytics
findings.description: CSP header style-src and script-src directives omit fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com, and static.cloudflareinsights.com, throwing console errors and blocking external fonts.
findings.recommendation: Self-host fonts locally with WOFF2 and @font-face or update CSP header directives to whitelist required origins.

findings.title: Non-Trailing-Slash URLs Return 307 Temporary Redirect
findings.description: Requesting /png-to-jpg triggers a 307 Temporary Redirect to /png-to-jpg/ instead of a 301 Permanent Redirect.
findings.recommendation: Add 301 redirect rules for all 38 tools into public/_redirects.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Zero filler or generic AI marketing cliches across all tools
Accurate technical documentation of client-side browser conversion mechanics
Clear transparent privacy assurances

findings.title: Templated Repetitive Language Across 38 Tools
findings.description: content_quality.py flagged repetition score of 37 due to shared boilerplate privacy and upload instructions.
findings.recommendation: Introduce unique format comparison tables, benchmark matrices, and practical workflow examples per tool.

findings.title: Missing Author Byline & Dedicated About/Privacy Pages
findings.description: Header links for About and Privacy point to short homepage hash fragments; no author entity or cryptographic audit is documented.
findings.recommendation: Create dedicated /about/ and /privacy/ pages with engineering background, GitHub repo link, and DevTools privacy verification.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique descriptive <title> tags on all 40 published routes
Targeted meta descriptions within 120-160 character boundary
Strict single <h1> and semantic heading hierarchy
Visible HTML breadcrumbs and matching JSON-LD BreadcrumbList
Complete OpenGraph and Twitter card metadata with 1200x630px social image

findings.title: Internal Link Context Limited to End-of-Page Grid
findings.description: Internal cross-links between related tools exist only in a footer card grid without inline contextual body links.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual cross-references in format conversion explanations (e.g. mention WebP in PNG conversion copy).

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD without syntax errors on every page
WebApplication schema on all conversion tools
CollectionPage and ItemList schema on /tools/ directory
BreadcrumbList schema on all tool pages

findings.title: Deprecated HowTo Schema Present on All Tools
findings.description: Google officially deprecated HowTo rich results in September 2023. Continuing to emit HowTo schema adds payload without SERP benefit.
findings.recommendation: Remove HowTo schema block from build-seo-pages.js to save ~1.2 KB JSON-LD per page.

findings.title: Disconnected Schema Objects Without Entity Graph
findings.description: JSON-LD emits top-level array of anonymous objects rather than a connected @graph with Organization publisher and @id links.
findings.recommendation: Refactor JSON-LD into a unified @graph with Organization, WebSite, and WebApplication entities.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Static HTML footprint under 14 KB
Vite-bundled JavaScript and CSS with cache-busting hashes
Sub-50ms TTFB across Cloudflare global edge network
Zero blocking third-party tracking scripts

findings.title: CSS @import Google Fonts Cascade
findings.description: src/styles/main.css line 1 imports Google Fonts via CSS @import, chaining stylesheet requests and delaying FCP/LCP.
findings.recommendation: Self-host font files locally or move stylesheet link to HTML head with preconnect.

findings.title: Zero Modern Preload and Speculation Rules
findings.description: Preload audit score was 50/100; no Speculation Rules or resource hints exist for top navigation paths.
findings.recommendation: Implement Speculation Rules API on homepage and tools directory for instant prerendering.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness & GEO
what_works: Content completely readable without JavaScript execution (359 words SSR)
Zero robot disallows for AI search crawlers in robots.txt
Clear differentiation as zero-upload client-side privacy tool

findings.title: Missing /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt
findings.description: agentic_check.py returned HTTP 404 for /llms.txt, missing out on direct indexing by AI agents and LLM citation engines.
findings.recommendation: Deploy public/llms.txt detailing all 38 tools and client-side processing guarantees.

findings.title: Missing Outbound Authoritative RFC Links
findings.description: Tool pages lack outbound citations to official specifications (RFC 4180, W3C SVG2) that boost generative authority.
findings.recommendation: Add links to IETF and W3C standards on data and SVG tool pages as outlined in PROMOTION.md.

categories.name: Images SEO
what_works: 1200x630px high-resolution OpenGraph image verified
180x180px Apple touch icon and 32x32px PNG favicon configured
SVG favicon fallback embedded in head

findings.title: No Illustrative Visual Diagrams on Tool Pages
findings.description: Tool pages rely solely on text and dropzone containers without visual workflow diagrams or schema ImageObject metadata.
findings.recommendation: Add lightweight SVG conversion diagram illustrating before/after format characteristics on key tools.
